properties.displayName: Sentinel TI - Active File Hash IOC Match Against MDE Process and File Activity
properties.description: [Added 2026 threat-model expansion] Correlates active STIX MD5/SHA1/SHA256 indicators with Defender for Endpoint process and file telemetry. This catches newly imported malicious hashes without editing the analytics rule.
properties.query:
let TI = materialize(
    ThreatIntelIndicators
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
    | where IsDeleted == false and IsActive == true
    | where isempty(ValidUntil) or ValidUntil > now()
    | where ObservableKey has 'file:hashes'
    | extend HashAlgorithm=case(ObservableKey has 'SHA-256','SHA256', ObservableKey has 'SHA-1','SHA1', ObservableKey has 'MD5','MD5',''),
             FileHashValue=tolower(tostring(ObservableValue))
    | where isnotempty(HashAlgorithm) and isnotempty(FileHashValue)
    | project IndicatorId=Id, HashAlgorithm, FileHashValue, Confidence, IndicatorName=tostring(Data.name), IndicatorDescription=tostring(Data.description), Tags
);
let HashEvents = union isfuzzy=true
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
    | extend Hashes=pack_array(pack('Algorithm','SHA256','Value',tolower(SHA256)), pack('Algorithm','SHA1','Value',tolower(SHA1)), pack('Algorithm','MD5','Value',tolower(MD5)))
    | mv-expand Hashes
    | extend HashAlgorithm=tostring(Hashes.Algorithm), FileHashValue=tostring(Hashes.Value)
    | where isnotempty(FileHashValue)
    | project TimeGenerated, DataSource='DeviceProcessEvents', DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
              UserPrincipalName=AccountUpn, HashAlgorithm, FileHashValue
),
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
    | extend Hashes=pack_array(pack('Algorithm','SHA256','Value',tolower(SHA256)), pack('Algorithm','SHA1','Value',tolower(SHA1)), pack('Algorithm','MD5','Value',tolower(MD5)))
    | mv-expand Hashes
    | extend HashAlgorithm=tostring(Hashes.Algorithm), FileHashValue=tostring(Hashes.Value)
    | where isnotempty(FileHashValue)
    | project TimeGenerated, DataSource='DeviceFileEvents', DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              UserPrincipalName=InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, HashAlgorithm, FileHashValue
);
HashEvents
| join kind=inner TI on HashAlgorithm, FileHashValue
| project TimeGenerated, DataSource, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, UserPrincipalName,
          HashAlgorithm, FileHashValue, IndicatorId, Confidence, IndicatorName, IndicatorDescription, Tags
